## Overview

Apixaban is described in the supplied sources as a novel oral direct factor Xa inhibitor ([src_81e343c146c92d15d7c2f15b65748ce1](viking://user/ulab0001/resources/p/pmed01/sources/src_81e343c146c92d15d7c2f15b65748ce1.md)). The dose studied in the atrial fibrillation population is 5 mg twice daily ([src_81e343c146c92d15d7c2f15b65748ce1](viking://user/ulab0001/resources/p/pmed01/sources/src_81e343c146c92d15d7c2f15b65748ce1.md), [src_ee77d1914d18a5ece9857b4e40a81405](viking://user/ulab0001/resources/p/pmed01/sources/src_ee77d1914d18a5ece9857b4e40a81405.md)).

## Comparators studied

- Versus [warfarin](./warfarin.md) (target international normalized ratio 2.0 to 3.0) in 18,201 patients with atrial fibrillation and at least one additional stroke risk factor ([src_81e343c146c92d15d7c2f15b65748ce1](viking://user/ulab0001/resources/p/pmed01/sources/src_81e343c146c92d15d7c2f15b65748ce1.md)).
- Versus [aspirin](./aspirin.md) (81 to 324 mg per day) in 5,599 patients for whom vitamin K antagonist therapy was unsuitable ([src_ee77d1914d18a5ece9857b4e40a81405](viking://user/ulab0001/resources/p/pmed01/sources/src_ee77d1914d18a5ece9857b4e40a81405.md)).

## Development and sponsorship

Both trials were funded by Bristol-Myers Squibb and [Pfizer](./pfizer.md) ([src_81e343c146c92d15d7c2f15b65748ce1](viking://user/ulab0001/resources/p/pmed01/sources/src_81e343c146c92d15d7c2f15b65748ce1.md), [src_ee77d1914d18a5ece9857b4e40a81405](viking://user/ulab0001/resources/p/pmed01/sources/src_ee77d1914d18a5ece9857b4e40a81405.md)).
